options.name: Compressed Schedule
options.tradeoff: Longer workdays may be tiring for some employees
options.concern: Potential impact on customer service and support
options.best_for: Employees with family responsibilities or long commutes

options.name: Flexible Schedule
options.upside: Improved work-life balance and flexibility for employees
options.tradeoff: Potential impact on team collaboration and communication
options.concern: Difficulty in managing workload and meeting deadlines
options.best_for: Employees with variable schedules or frequent appointments

options.name: Summer Hours

options.tradeoff: Potential impact on workload and productivity during other seasons
options.concern: Inequity for employees who do not get to enjoy the extra time off
options.best_for: Employees who value a break during the summer

options.name: Traditional Schedule
options.tradeoff: Less flexibility for employees with family or other responsibilities
options.concern: Potential negative impact on employee satisfaction and retention
options.best_for: Employees who prefer a traditional schedule and routine
